source.description: The source blob where the citation was found.

sourceType.description: Type of the source where the citation was found, such as a document or comment.

sourceContext.description: Context within the source; the block id when the source is a document or comment.

author.description: Account uid of the blob's author.

sourceBlob.description: The blob that contains the citation.

sourceDocument.description: Document where the citation was found; relevant when the source is a comment.

target.description: The resource the link points to.

targetVersion.description: Version of the target the link points to, if the link specifies one.

isExactVersion.description: Whether the link pins the exact target version rather than a suggested minimum version.

targetBlockRevision.description: Revision of the target block at `targetVersion`, when the fragment points to a block or range.

mentionType.description: Kind of mention, such as `embed` or `link`.

isExact.description: Exactness flag not emitted by the current daemon citation message; prefer `isExactVersion`.

description: A citation in raw indexed form, before client-side resolution into a citation read model.
